decisions.reason: As an adjacent multi-model consumer-health line for an expanding large pharma firm, it likely still offers enough portfolio value at low carrying cost to justify keeping it unless sales are clearly weak.

This hair-and-skin supplement remains a pharmacy-channel adjacency with modest maintenance cost, so the firm would usually keep it, though as a single niche product it is easier to prune than the broader line.

After several years the niche mushroom-based immune supplement should have revealed its market potential, and if it has not become a clear winner the firm would reallocate resources to stronger products and new development.

Despite the earlier Valsartan-related negative signal, a generic blood-pressure medicine fits a large pharmaceutical firm's core prescription and generics capabilities, so if it is still marketed in 2022 it is more likely to be retained while monitored closely.

The OTC migraine triptan is a strategically attractive consumer-health extension with its own page and plausible pharmacy demand, so the firm would likely continue it unless repeat sales have disappointed.
